rationale: Flagship ZBS event page but one of 14 sections on zbs-giz.si; covered by monitoring the ZBS newsroom/parent.
ZBS newsroom is a durable dated feed of association press releases and post-conference records.
Bančni vestnik on its own subdomain is a standalone recurring trade-journal archive with per-issue indexes.
Single BSI publication section among 24 siblings; captured by monitoring the Banka Slovenije media hub.
DSI annual conference sites plus zbornik proceedings are a recurring archive of bank IT roadmaps and vendors.
Organiser event listing worth mining once for sponsor/vendor leads around DSI.
Annual LJSE/Finance conference programme naming bank CEOs and session topics; standalone recurring source.
Commercial organiser conference index; mine once for dated finance events and speaker rosters.
Recurring Delo-run conference dedicated to payments/mobile tech with named bank and PSP speakers.
CEE fintech/payments conference agenda where Slovenian bank and processor executives state roadmaps in English.
Single Finextra article listing EBAday speakers; useful evidence, not a continuing feed.
Wikipedia stand-in for Sibos; low SI-specific yield until a real sibos.com agenda URL is confirmed.
One siol.net article on WEBSI 2025 winners; evidence of digital projects, the WEBSI site would be the true source.
Single-edition bank ranking page; useful comparative evidence, reachability of future editions unproven.
Issuer-maintained awards pages are recurring self-declared achievement disclosures with dates and criteria.
Annual international award programme with a stable Slovenia country winner and citation text.
Valuable annual country citations but Euromoney is typically subscription-gated; access must be cleared.
Recurring SI tax/finance conference; peripheral to payments but useful for actor mapping.
Generic event aggregator; cheap one-off discovery layer, too noisy for continuous monitoring.
GZS dated event calendar is a broad standalone pointer to finance/ICT conferences with sector actors.
Single YouTube recording; the ZBS channel rather than this video would be the monitorable source.
One STA item covering a ZBS event; agency coverage is evidence, the STA feed itself is partly gated.
Petrol press room is a live feed on merchant-issued cards and wallet/payment launches; in scope per do_not_narrow.
Product and general-terms pages on a distinct domain give fact-dense issuing/processing detail.
SPAR media room documents acceptance-side instant-payment (Flik) rollouts at POS; recurring primary source.
Mercator news and terms track Pika card and Moj M wallet — deepest merchant-issued payments footprint in SI grocery.
Pošta Slovenije annual reports carry money-services segment data and statutory disclosures; recurring.
Listed issuer's regulated-disclosure page; carrier billing and payment partnerships on a dated cadence.
